title: Identification of Alzheimer's disease using a convolutional neural network model based on T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging.
summary: A slice-based CNN discriminated AD from controls in two populations with explicit cross-population evaluation; this supports bounded diagnostic-method evidence, not clinical utility.
